title: BUI Catalog (Blender interface)
description: Blender's interface components from BUI (github.com/ppmpreetham/BUI) as an A2UI catalog: properties-editor layouts, number fields and sliders, enums, color pickers, lists, outliner trees, menus, pie menus, color ramps, curves, histograms and node editors.
instructions: Build Blender-style property UIs: wrap groups in Panel components inside a Column; use Split or the label prop for "Label  [value]" rows; use Column/Row align=true for joined widget groups (e.g. Location X/Y/Z or EnumRow). Icons are Blender icon names (MESH_CUBE, LIGHT_SUN, HIDE_OFF, RENDER_STILL ...). Bind every user-editable value to the data model with {"@path": ...} so edits flow back to the agent; give commit-style widgets (Button, MenuButton, ListView ...) an action whose context reads the bound paths. Repeated rows (lists of keymap entries, jobs, waypoints, nodes) should use a ChildList template. NodeEditor children are Node components keyed by `key`; links reference node keys and socket index or name.
